description: This file defines the class DefaultIndexKey, which represents a MongoDB index key with a specific field name and index direction. It includes methods for creation, equality, and string representation, and references external classes like IndexDirection and BsonInt32.

classes.name: DefaultIndexKey
classes.description: Immutable class representing a MongoDB index key with a specific field name and direction.

methods.name: of(String fieldName)
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultIndexKey with the specified field name and default index direction.

methods.name: of(String fieldName, IndexDirection direction)
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultIndexKey with the specified field name and index direction.

methods.name: getFieldName()
methods.description: Returns the name of the field for this index key.

methods.name: getBsonValue()
methods.description: Returns the BSON integer representation of the index direction.
